title: Travel: John Lennon – Bombay to London | 1969
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono returned to London from Bombay, India, on 24 November 1969.

They had arrived in India in the early hours of 19 November.

They returned to England on the 8pm flight from Santacruz Airport in Bombay, arriving at Heathrow Airport in the early hours of the following morning.
